candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout; traces and logs show the 500 originating at order:8000, not at the gateway.

report.explanation: All checkout 502s correlate with order-service 500s on /v1/orders in traces and logs; gateway itself is healthy (/readyz 200). Root cause lies downstream at order, but the specific internal fault is not yet observed.
